the_seam.discovery: The slug-existence seam ALREADY EXISTS of record — hub.hrefs (lib/courses.ts), built for the course page/tree expander: noteSubtopic[noteId] -> subtopicCode; hrefs.questions[code] = the exam-questions set anchored there (first in corpus order, the established default-target law); hrefs.flashcards[code] = the subtopic's deck, set ONLY when a card resolves to it (cardsBySubtopic parity). Both maps derive from the SAME inventory the receiving pages resolve (questionTopics[].slug / index.subtopicByCode), so a resolved href cannot 404.
safety_properties: no slug synthesis anywhere — the flow renders hrefs handed to it, resolved server-side from the committed corpus inventory
fail-closed fallback: a note without the subtopic binding, or with no set/deck anchored there, gets the course-level pages (the #399 always-live behavior, byte-for-byte)
no dynamicParams=false on either receiving page (verified) — non-pilot params SSR on demand
colon-bearing subtopic codes: receiving page decodes tolerantly (both raw and percent-encoded hit) — hrefs passed verbatim, same strings the tree expander ships
